pages.text: This chapter introduces how to perform surgery.
Before performing any type of surgery, you must administer morphine for analgesia. Otherwise, the patient will suffer severe surgical shock, causing significant brain damage.
Procedure:$(li)Make an incision$(li)Clamp bleeding vessels$(li)Retract the skin$(li)Clean the wound with tweezers$(li)Suture the incision.
Procedure:$(li)Make an incision$(li)Clamp bleeding vessels$(li)Retract the skin$(li)Implant bone material$(li)Suture the incision.
